name: Kubernetes
description: Cluster, node and job dashboards with pod and workload alerts, from the OpenTelemetry collector.
details:
## Setup

Collected by the OpenTelemetry Collector. See [Kubernetes with the OpenTelemetry Collector](https://docs.kloudfuse.com/platform/latest/integration/otel/kubernetes/).

Run the collector as a DaemonSet with the Kubernetes and system-level metrics receivers enabled.
